vn:1491002000.what_it_is: Vietnamese audiobook, ebook, book-summary, podcast, meditation and sleep-story library pitched as '15 minutes a day' of self-development.
vn:1491002000.sets_apart: Daily-dose framing ('15 minutes a day' that turns commute, workout or lunch break into learning) over studio-recorded, human-narrated bestsellers; one app mixes growth audio with meditation and bedtime stories.
vn:1491002000.lens_note: K3 core: audio for commute/exercise with a fixed daily time budget, but browse-a-catalogue rather than personalised or goal-driven. K1/K2 loose (meditation and sleep stories; summaries are one content type).
vn:1491002000.women_evidence: General self-development audience; no gender cues.
vn:1491002000.monetization: Free download; paid access model not visible in the truncated description (audiobook subscription/IAP likely - inference).
vn:1491002000.traction: 34k ratings in VN (4.7) since Apr 2020; also in US store with 1.7k ratings (diaspora likely - inference).
vn:1491002000.export_reason: Content-bound: Vietnamese bestsellers (rights presumably licensed - inference) recorded in-house by human voice talent. Only the fixed daily time budget and the book + summary + sleep bundle travel.
vn:1491002000.idea_seed: A '15 minutes a day' audio ritual for US Gen Z women: pick one growth goal and get a daily 15-minute queue (summary, calm-down or wind-down audio) sized to the commute or workout slot.
vn:1491002000.build_components: Audio player (background, offline, sleep timer), catalogue/CMS and search, subscription paywall, daily-queue logic. Content licensing or AI/TTS generation is the real bottleneck, not dev effort.

jp:1047462806.name_en: Minchalle: Habit Challenge with Anonymous Teams
jp:1047462806.what_it_is: Habit app where you join an anonymous team of 5 strangers with the same goal and report daily progress with photo proof in a team chat.
jp:1047462806.sets_apart: Accountability through tiny anonymous pods instead of solo streaks or a public feed: photo proof, stamps and comments in a 5-person chat, plus invite-only teams with friends. Claims 8x higher 21-day continuation than going solo (developer's own claim).
jp:1047462806.lens_note: K1 core: habits + peer accountability + soft encouragement without public performance. K2 loose: study/language challenges are one of 30+ categories.
jp:1047462806.women_evidence: Diet, beauty and health challenges are prominent, but no explicit female targeting.
jp:1047462806.monetization: Free download; paid tier not stated in the visible description (premium/IAP likely - inference).
jp:1047462806.traction: 35k ratings in JP (4.66) since Nov 2015, not in US store; 16,902 active teams (Apr 2024, self-reported); featured by NHK/Nikkei per description.
jp:1047462806.export_reason: Photo-proof + stamps mechanic is language-agnostic and store metadata lists 13 languages incl. EN; hurdles are cold-start matching per goal, culture (polite anonymous Japanese community vs US toxicity risk - inference) and moderation of chats between strangers.
jp:1047462806.idea_seed: Tiny accountability pods for US Gen Z women: 5 people (friends or matched), one shared goal (6am routine, gym, study), a daily photo-proof drop and emoji reactions, no follower counts.
jp:1047462806.build_components: Group chat with photo upload (managed chat SDK), goal-based team matching, push reminders/daily cut-off, moderation (report/block), subscription; anonymous mode needs trust and safety work.

kr:1505220130.what_it_is: Korean to-do, routine and emoji-diary planner for MZ (millennial + Gen Z) users with a colour-coded calendar and per-task timer.
kr:1505220130.sets_apart: Treats the to-do list as a 'pretty daily record': to-dos are colour-coded to decorate the calendar, each task has a timer that saves time spent, and every diary day gets a representative emoji.
kr:1505220130.lens_note: K1 core: routine + diary + aesthetic daily record; no learning or audio angle.
kr:1505220130.women_evidence: 'Easy and pretty' record, decorative calendar and emoji diary suggest an aesthetic/youth skew, but no explicit female targeting.
kr:1505220130.monetization: Free download; paid tier not stated in the short description (premium/IAP likely - inference).
kr:1505220130.traction: 108k ratings in KR (4.78) since Aug 2020; 1.5k US ratings; claims 3M MZ users.
kr:1505220130.export_reason: Mechanic (colour, timer, emoji) is language-agnostic, the app already ships an EN UI and has a small US footprint; to-do/planner is a crowded US category (inference), so aesthetics and the 'daily record' framing must carry it.
kr:1505220130.idea_seed: A pretty-first daily planner for US Gen Z women where each day is both a to-do list and a diary page: colour-coded tasks fill an aesthetic calendar, a per-task timer logs effort, and the day closes with one mood emoji.
kr:1505220130.build_components: To-do/routine CRUD, calendar with colour themes, task timer, emoji diary, widgets and reminders, cloud sync.

cn:1562071067.what_it_is: Habit check-in and focus app with a Little-Prince-like companion world (inference: YoYo, a little fox and a rose) where effort earns 'roses' spendable in an in-app shop.
cn:1562071067.sets_apart: Soft discipline through a nagging-but-kind companion (the fox monitors, encourages and reminds) and a rose currency spent on postcards and small gifts (shop with free shipping); adds co-study 'planets', 3-5 friend check-in groups, outfits for YoYo and a mood diary.
cn:1562071067.lens_note: K1 core: cute companion, mood diary, friends check-in groups, soft discipline, collectible and real-world rewards. K2 loose: focus/study check-ins and class schedule, no learning content.
cn:1562071067.women_evidence: Inferred from the cute character world, dress-up outfits for YoYo, postcard/gift rewards and mood diary; no explicit 'for girls' statement.
cn:1562071067.monetization: Free download; rose currency and in-app shop (goods bought with roses); paid tier not stated (IAP/premium likely - inference).
cn:1562071067.traction: 37k ratings in CN (4.71) since Apr 2021; 102 US ratings; last updated Oct 2025 (a year ago).
cn:1562071067.export_reason: Companion + currency + dress-up loop is language-agnostic, but the Chinese 'self-discipline check-in' and study-room culture and physical-goods fulfilment are culture- and logistics-bound; weak US pull and a year without updates.
cn:1562071067.idea_seed: A kind-but-nagging companion for US Gen Z women: daily check-ins earn 'roses' that unlock outfits and mailable stickers/postcards, with 3-5 friend check-in groups and 'study with me' rooms.
cn:1562071067.build_components: Habit check-ins, focus timer, mood diary, friend groups, real-time co-study rooms, character customisation, virtual currency and shop (physical fulfilment is an ops cost).

cn:1046787451.what_it_is: Minimal one-tap habit check-in app by a likely solo developer with a month-calendar streak view and completion rewards.
cn:1046787451.sets_apart: Little beyond a standard habit tracker: one-tap check-in, month calendar, goal rewards and an explicit 'a break can be restarted' framing; differentiated mainly by ten years of longevity and minimalism.
cn:1046787451.lens_note: K1 relevant but generic habit tracking; no companion, social or journal layer.
cn:1046787451.monetization: Free download; no monetization stated (IAP possible - inference).
cn:1046787451.traction: 1.5k ratings in CN (4.74) since Oct 2015; 22 US ratings; still updated Oct 2026.
cn:1046787451.export_reason: Language-agnostic but generic, with no distinctive hook and tiny US traction (22 ratings); nothing to export beyond commodity habit tracking.
cn:1046787451.idea_seed: Borrow only the forgiving-streak framing: a missed day is a 'restart', not a reset to zero, shown as part of the journey in a gentle habit app for US Gen Z women.
cn:1046787451.build_components: Habit CRUD, one-tap check-in, month calendar, streak logic, reminders and rewards.

jp:1120239484.name_en: Keizoku Suru Gijutsu ('The Skill of Sticking With It'): Habit Tracker for Diet & Workouts
jp:1120239484.what_it_is: Free, ad-free habit app that coaches users to set deliberately small, sustainable goals so habits survive the inevitable drop in motivation.
jp:1120239484.sets_apart: Assumes motivation will fade and steers users to 'goals that last' (e.g. just logging meals before gym sessions) instead of only tracking streaks; ad-free with voluntary 'support' IAP, and publishes its own stats (94.9% quit the gym within 30 days; 12,000 users a month reach 30 days).
jp:1120239484.lens_note: K1 core: habit formation through gentle, goal-shrinking coaching (soft discipline). No learning or audio angle.
jp:1120239484.women_evidence: Diet and workout framing; no explicit gender targeting.
jp:1120239484.monetization: Free, no ads; optional voluntary in-app purchases to support the developer (per description).
jp:1120239484.traction: 53k ratings in JP (4.78) since Jun 2016; 60 US ratings; claims #1 JP habit app (self-reported); store metadata lists 32 languages.
jp:1120239484.export_reason: The goal-shrinking coaching logic is language-agnostic and could be an onboarding flow, but the tip-jar model is not a subscription business and US pull is weak (60 ratings despite 32 listed languages).
jp:1120239484.idea_seed: A 'make it tiny' goal wizard for US Gen Z women: onboarding assumes motivation will dip, rewrites an ambitious goal (gym 5x a week) into a minimum habit (2-minute stretch) and ladders up only after consistent wins.
jp:1120239484.build_components: Habit tracker core, goal-shrinking wizard (rules or LLM), progress stats, reminders.

jp:1201200202.name_en: Ankimaker: Test Study Flashcard & Quiz Maker
jp:1201200202.what_it_is: Quiz/flashcard builder where students create their own question sets in several formats, import via CSV or scan notes with AI, and share sets with friends.
jp:1201200202.sets_apart: Make-your-own-quiz focus: fill-in-the-blank, multi-select and image questions, AI question generation from scanned textbook/notes, a web editor and CSV import, plus weak-question mode, term/meaning swap, read-aloud and friend sharing; claims 1.9M downloads.
jp:1201200202.lens_note: K2 core: the user's own material becomes quizzes (AI-from-scan, CSV). K3 loose: question read-aloud for commutes.
jp:1201200202.women_evidence: General student audience; no gender cues.
jp:1201200202.monetization: Free download; paywall not visible in the truncated description (subscription/IAP for AI features likely - inference).
jp:1201200202.traction: 13k ratings in JP (4.67) since Feb 2017; 402 US ratings; 1.9M downloads (self-reported); store metadata lists 29 languages; updated daily.
jp:1201200202.export_reason: Scan notes -> quiz and shareable decks is language-agnostic and already shows some pull outside JP (402 US ratings, 29 listed languages); category is crowded, so speed and UX must differentiate.
jp:1201200202.idea_seed: Snap a photo of lecture notes or a textbook page and get a quiz in seconds, then share the deck with a friend group: a 'study buddy' for US Gen Z women in college.
jp:1201200202.build_components: OCR + LLM question generation, several question types, weak-question/SRS logic, cloud sync and sharing, optional web editor; LLM/OCR cost control.

cn:1021094295.what_it_is: Japanese learning dictionary for Chinese speakers with handwriting and photo lookup, user/official word lists, spaced-repetition review and an assisted-reading mode.
cn:1021094295.sets_apart: A community layer on a dictionary: user and official word lists (e.g. JLPT N1), user Q&A for hard cases, 10+ review question types on a forgetting curve, tap-to-annotate reading of any long text or web page, and a 'listen mode' that loops a word list for shadowing.
cn:1021094295.lens_note: K2 relevant: user-chosen text and word lists feed SRS review and annotated reading. K3 loose: looping word-list audio for earphone listening.
cn:1021094295.women_evidence: General language-learner tool; no gender cues.
cn:1021094295.monetization: Free download + membership with auto-subscription (per the payment-agreement link in the description).
cn:1021094295.traction: 113k ratings in CN (4.81) since Jul 2015; 1.4k US ratings; 1M+ dictionary entries claimed.
cn:1021094295.export_reason: Content-bound: a Japanese dictionary for Chinese speakers; the reading-annotation + word-list-audio mechanic is portable in principle but competes with established flashcard/reader tools (inference).
cn:1021094295.idea_seed: Paste or photograph any text and get a tap-to-define reading layer that auto-builds a word list, which then loops as a short audio playlist for the commute.
cn:1021094295.build_components: OCR/web-text import, tap-to-define annotation, auto word-list builder (LLM), SRS, TTS playlists; the dictionary data itself is the content-heavy part.

cn:1016323413.name_en: Dedao: Courses, Audio Book Digests & Ebooks
cn:1016323413.what_it_is: Chinese lifelong-learning platform selling expert-led courses, 110k+ ebooks and audio book digests (about half an hour per book), with an AI study assistant.
cn:1016323413.sets_apart: Expert-branded knowledge store (200+ named professors and entrepreneurs) built around a 'half an hour a day to master a book' habit via 4,000 listen-able digests, plus an AI learning assistant and learning circle; brand and content, not mechanics, are the moat.
cn:1016323413.lens_note: K3 core: 4,000 audio digests as a daily listening habit. K2 relevant: time-boxed digests plus an AI study assistant. K1 loose: self-improvement content.
cn:1016323413.women_evidence: Management, economics, history and leadership lineup; no female cues.
cn:1016323413.monetization: Free download; sells courses and ebooks and (likely) memberships; prices not in the description.
cn:1016323413.traction: 32k ratings in CN (4.45) since Nov 2015; 567 US ratings; 1M+ learners on flagship courses (self-reported).
cn:1016323413.export_reason: Content- and expert-brand-bound (Mandarin experts); only the daily-digest ritual and AI study assistant travel, both established formats in the US (inference). Likely a large company rather than a small developer.
cn:1016323413.idea_seed: A 'half an hour a day' digest track for US Gen Z women (one personal-finance or relationships book per week) with an AI study buddy you can ask follow-ups about what you just heard.
cn:1016323413.build_components: Audio player, digest generation pipeline (LLM + TTS or licensed), AI Q&A over the digest, daily queue and progress; content licensing or generation is the real cost.

kr:1598278474.name_en: Allcl (All Clear): Study Timer, To-Do, Challenges, Vocab, Diary
kr:1598278474.what_it_is: Study and 'god-saeng' (hyper-productive lifestyle) all-in-one app from a planner brand: study timer that blocks other apps, to-do, verified routine missions, study clubs, vocab and diary.
kr:1598278474.sets_apart: Brand crossover from a physical planner company: study time auto-fills the brand's 'Ten-Minute Planner' grid and converts into cash spendable in an in-app store; the timer blocks other apps; routine 'missions' (e.g. 6am miracle morning) are proven with other people and clubs group users by school, age or goal.
kr:1598278474.lens_note: K1 relevant: routine missions with proof, diary, clubs and the 'god-saeng' trend, but study/exam-centred and intense rather than gentle. K2 loose: vocab list and study timer.
kr:1598278474.women_evidence: Planner brand and diary/shop elements, but no explicit gender cues.
kr:1598278474.monetization: Free download; study 'cash' economy redeemable in a store (likely brand merchandise - inference); other monetization not stated.
kr:1598278474.traction: 7.6k ratings in KR (4.68) since Dec 2021; 34 US ratings.
kr:1598278474.export_reason: Tied to Korean exam/planner culture and a merch store from an established planner brand; the earn-by-studying loop and app-blocking timer are portable but need a merch partner.
kr:1598278474.idea_seed: 'Get rewarded for focusing': study and routine time converts to credits redeemable for real stationery or merch from a partner brand, with 6am-routine missions verified by a small club.
kr:1598278474.build_components: Focus timer with app blocking (needs Apple Screen Time/FamilyControls entitlement on iOS), to-do, mission proof + clubs, credit economy and store (merch fulfilment via partner).

jp:1512361252.what_it_is: AI journaling app that analyses entries and sends daily 'inspirations' plus weekly and monthly 'insight' reports written like a letter from a friend.
jp:1512361252.sets_apart: Closes the journaling feedback loop: a daily inspiration prompt and periodic long-form insight reports (patterns in thoughts, values, desires) in a friend-letter tone, plus guided journaling (answer questions) positioned for self-analysis (e.g. job hunting) and for people who cannot be honest on social media.
jp:1512361252.lens_note: K1 core: journaling, self-knowledge/identity, self-care, private non-social space.
jp:1512361252.women_evidence: Self-care and private-space framing; no explicit female targeting.
jp:1512361252.monetization: Free download; paid tier not stated in the visible description (subscription likely - inference).
jp:1512361252.traction: 21k ratings in JP (4.66) since Nov 2020; not in US store; JA only. Seller name 'Nissay MIRAIQA' (Nissay is a major Japanese life-insurer brand - inference) suggests corporate backing.
jp:1512361252.export_reason: LLM pattern-finding works in any language and AI journaling has clear US analogues (inference); risks are a crowded niche, sensitive personal data (privacy, encryption) and mental-health claims/crisis handling.
jp:1512361252.idea_seed: An AI journal that sends US Gen Z women a weekly 'letter from a friend' about their patterns, wins and recurring worries, plus one tiny daily prompt and a shareable monthly 'you in review' card.
jp:1512361252.build_components: Journal editor with search, LLM pipeline for prompts and weekly/monthly insights (privacy, encryption, redaction), notifications, subscription; crisis-content guardrails.

vn:1530683610.exclude_reason: Likely app-factory style thin wrapper (inference): an EPUB reader around a public 'books to read' list (Business Insider list sourced from Reddit) by a person-named seller with 6 apps and an ad-hosting (app-ads.txt) seller URL; no distinctive mechanic, no audio or learning feature visible.
vn:1530683610.what_it_is: EPUB reader app pre-loaded with a curated 'books worth reading once in your life' list.

cn:1627691759.what_it_is: Pomodoro/stopwatch focus timer where a chick grows during your session and dies if you quit, with collectible animal companions.
cn:1627691759.sets_apart: Loss aversion with a cute twist: abandoning a session kills the chick (finishing gives an adult chicken), plus a roster of companions (cat, bear, deer, balloon dog, dragon), an app whitelist that disables non-study apps, Live Activities/StandBy mode and a 'healing' aesthetic.
cn:1627691759.lens_note: K1 core: cute companion + soft (or not so soft) discipline. K2 loose: aimed at studying/focus, no learning content.
cn:1627691759.women_evidence: Cute 'healing' animal aesthetic suggests a youth, possibly female skew, but no explicit gender targeting.
cn:1627691759.monetization: Free download; paid tier not stated in the description (IAP for animals/features likely - inference).
cn:1627691759.traction: 51k ratings in CN (4.8) since Sep 2022; 1.1k US ratings; claims 1M+ users and App Store featuring in 110+ storefronts (self-reported).
cn:1627691759.export_reason: Language-agnostic, already localised (EN/JA/KO/ZH) and has US usage (1.1k ratings); the pet-focus-timer space is crowded (inference) and the 'dying chick' framing is harsh for a gentle audience.
cn:1627691759.idea_seed: A cute grow-together focus companion for US Gen Z women: each study or deep-work session grows a pet or plant, quitting early has a gentle consequence (the pet naps instead of dying), streaks unlock collectible companions, and an app whitelist protects the session.
cn:1627691759.build_components: Timer with animated pet states, collectible system, app blocking (iOS Screen Time API entitlement), Live Activities/widgets, stats, sync.

jp:1528015231.what_it_is: Free daily planner that lays out a day as a 24-hour pie chart with automatic time totals, diary and goals.
jp:1528015231.sets_apart: Shows the day as a 24-hour circle with one-tap entries and automatic per-category totals and trends, branded on a 'University of Tokyo graduate's time-management method'; end-of-day reflection by comparing planned time.
jp:1528015231.lens_note: K1 relevant: daily planning, routines and diary; productivity-flavoured rather than gentle.
jp:1528015231.women_evidence: Lists housewives among intended users; otherwise general.
jp:1528015231.monetization: Freemium: basic features free (per description); paid upgrade/ads implied but not detailed.
jp:1528015231.traction: 48k ratings in JP (4.73) since Aug 2020; 116 US ratings; #1 in its pie-chart-planner niche (self-reported).
jp:1528015231.export_reason: The 24-hour ring visual is language-agnostic and the app has an EN UI, but US pull is low (116 ratings), the 'Tokyo University' authority is culture-bound and planners are crowded (inference).
jp:1528015231.idea_seed: A 'my day as a pie' time-blocking planner for US Gen Z women: drag coloured slices (study, self-care, friends, sleep) onto a 24-hour ring and get a gentle end-of-day recap, shareable as an aesthetic card.
jp:1528015231.build_components: Circular chart UI, quick entry of time blocks, totals/trend charts, diary and goal notes, reminders.

jp:6449631650.name_en: Sugoi Ankicho ('Amazing Flashcards'): AI Makes Questions from Images
jp:6449631650.what_it_is: AI flashcard app that turns photos, PDFs, audio, web pages and YouTube videos into editable study cards, with a forgetting-curve 'today's study' queue and an AI tutor.
jp:6449631650.sets_apart: Multi-source ingestion (photo, PDF, audio, web, YouTube) into editable cards with an explicit review/edit step, AI-generated distractors for multiple choice, an 'AI sensei' for explanations and example sentences, a daily due-queue and public deck sharing with a study timeline.
jp:6449631650.lens_note: K2 core: the user's own materials become cards, quizzes and a daily review habit. K3 loose: read-aloud of words and sentences.
jp:6449631650.women_evidence: General student/exam audience; no gender cues.
jp:6449631650.monetization: Free download + Plus subscription (some features such as text input need the Plus plan, per description).
jp:6449631650.traction: 4.7k ratings in JP (4.62) since Jun 2023; listed in US store with 0 ratings (no US traction yet); updated Oct 2026.
jp:6449631650.export_reason: Any content -> cards is language-agnostic and the UI already ships in EN/JA; unproven in the US (0 ratings), AI accuracy needs a review step (the app discloses this itself) and copyright of uploaded material is a risk.
jp:6449631650.idea_seed: Drop in anything you are learning from (lecture PDF, YouTube link, voice memo, photo of notes) and get a swipeable deck plus a 5-minute 'due today' queue, with a friendly AI tutor explaining what you missed.
jp:6449631650.build_components: Multi-modal ingestion (OCR, PDF parse, audio transcription, web/YouTube transcripts), LLM card + distractor generation with edit UI, SRS scheduler, sharing/timeline; LLM cost management.

jp:1439938837.name_en: DotHabit: Habit Tracker with AI Coach
jp:1439938837.what_it_is: Habit tracker that shows every completion as a filled dot, with one-tap logging and an AI coach character, 'DotBuddy', that cheers each log.
jp:1439938837.sets_apart: Dot-grid visualisation makes accumulated effort visible at a glance; logging takes seconds; missed days can be recorded too ('could not do it') and an AI companion reacts to each entry with congratulations/encouragement, framing logs as 'proof you can trust yourself'.
jp:1439938837.lens_note: K1 core: habit tracking with a gentle AI companion and no-shame miss logging.
jp:1439938837.monetization: Free download; paid tier not stated in the visible description (IAP/subscription likely - inference).
jp:1439938837.traction: 17k ratings in JP (4.67) since Oct 2018; 121 US ratings; 1M+ downloads worldwide (self-reported); 14 store languages. Same app (trackId) as kr:1439938837.
jp:1439938837.export_reason: Dots + AI buddy are language-agnostic, store metadata lists 14 languages and 1M global downloads are claimed; US pull so far is small (121 ratings) and habit trackers are crowded (inference).
jp:1439938837.idea_seed: A habit tracker where every check-in fills a dot in a growing visual pattern and a gentle AI buddy reacts to each log, including missed days logged without guilt, for US Gen Z women.
jp:1439938837.build_components: Habit CRUD, dot-grid/calendar visualisation, widgets, notifications, scripted or LLM buddy reactions.

cn:1048518210.name_en: Now Meditation: Mindfulness, Sleep Aid & White Noise
cn:1048518210.what_it_is: Chinese-language meditation and sleep app with guided mindfulness, breathing, sound-bath, white-noise and bedtime-story audio and a personalised practice plan.
cn:1048518210.sets_apart: Generates a custom meditation plan from your past practice and goals; scenario-based sessions (relationships, 'focus and self-discipline', 'solo healing') and 5-10 minute morning sessions; the title also advertises sleep monitoring and HRV stress features (not detailed in the visible text).
cn:1048518210.lens_note: K1 relevant: mindfulness, emotion management, sleep rituals. K3 loose: audio library, but mostly stationary (sleep/relax) rather than on-the-go.
cn:1048518210.monetization: Free download; paid content tier not stated in the truncated description (subscription likely - inference).
cn:1048518210.traction: 36k ratings in CN (4.63) since Feb 2016; 276 US ratings.
cn:1048518210.export_reason: Content-bound: studio-voiced Mandarin audio library, in a US meditation market dominated by large incumbents (inference); the plan-from-goals intake is portable.
cn:1048518210.idea_seed: A 'tell us where you are and what you want' intake that builds a 7-day personalised audio plan (morning 5-minute reset, commute focus, evening wind-down) for US Gen Z women, scenario-based rather than a generic library.
cn:1048518210.build_components: Audio player (background/offline), plan builder from intake, scenario library (TTS/AI voice or recorded), reminders, subscription; sleep/HRV sensing is out of scope for the slice.

kr:1439938837.what_it_is: Habit tracker that shows every completion as a filled dot, with one-tap logging and an AI coach character, 'DotBuddy', that cheers each log (Korean storefront listing of the same app as jp:1439938837).
kr:1439938837.sets_apart: Dot-grid visualisation makes accumulated effort visible at a glance; logging takes seconds; missed days can be recorded too and an AI companion reacts to each entry. The KR listing is localised with local trend words ('god-saeng', 'streak') in the title - a marketing-localisation tactic (inference).
kr:1439938837.lens_note: K1 core: habit tracking with a gentle AI companion and no-shame miss logging.
kr:1439938837.monetization: Free download; paid tier not stated in the visible description (IAP/subscription likely - inference).
kr:1439938837.traction: 2.4k ratings in KR (4.76) for the same app that has 17k ratings in JP, since Oct 2018; 121 US ratings; 1M+ downloads worldwide (self-reported).
kr:1439938837.export_reason: Dots + AI buddy are language-agnostic, store metadata lists 14 languages and the developer already adapts store copy per country; US pull is small (121 ratings) and habit trackers are crowded (inference).
kr:1439938837.idea_seed: A habit tracker where every check-in fills a dot in a growing visual pattern and a gentle AI buddy reacts to each log, including missed days logged without guilt, for US Gen Z women.
kr:1439938837.build_components: Habit CRUD, dot-grid/calendar visualisation, widgets, notifications, scripted or LLM buddy reactions.

cn:963152777.what_it_is: Chinese book-explanation platform where named expert narrators distil a book in about 45 minutes, plus courses and social 'training camps'.
cn:963152777.sets_apart: Narrator-branded digest series (one explicitly told from a 'clear-headed female perspective') and cohort-style 'training camps' that add community, teaching sessions and events around the content, i.e. accountability layered on top of consumption.
cn:963152777.lens_note: K3 relevant: listen-to-digest format (audio inferred from matched keywords; description truncated). K1 loose: self-growth, one female-perspective series, camps resemble accountability groups. K2 loose: 45-minute digests.
cn:963152777.women_evidence: General audience; only one series (classics) is framed from a female perspective.
cn:963152777.monetization: Free download; paid memberships, courses and camps are listed as products (prices not in the visible text).
cn:963152777.traction: 55k ratings in CN (4.72) since Feb 2015; 556 US ratings.
cn:963152777.export_reason: Host- and Mandarin-content-bound, run by what looks like a large content brand (inference); the transferable piece is cohort camps around audio content.
cn:963152777.idea_seed: Pair each audio digest with a small 7- or 14-day 'camp' of friends: a daily listen check-in and one discussion prompt, a book club on the go for US Gen Z women.
cn:963152777.build_components: Audio player, small-group camps with daily check-in and discussion, content pipeline (AI digests or licensed), notifications.

cn:1552314395.name_en: flomo: Minimal Note Capture with AI Insights
cn:1552314395.what_it_is: Microblog-style note app for capturing fleeting thoughts, with AI that links related notes, surfaces themes and blind spots and answers questions from your past notes, plus daily review pushes.
cn:1552314395.sets_apart: Radical minimalism (the listing even states what the app is 'not good at'), capture without opening the app (WeChat input, voice transcription), a daily 'review' that resurfaces old notes via push/widget, and AI that reveals recurring themes, blind spots and deep questions from your own notes.
cn:1552314395.lens_note: K1 relevant: journal-like reflection and self-insight with a daily review ritual. K2 relevant: user's own notes resurfaced as cards with AI insight, though not turned into quizzes.
cn:1552314395.women_evidence: General thinkers/creators/learners audience; no gender cues.
cn:1552314395.monetization: Free download; paid plan not stated in the visible description (Pro membership likely - inference).
cn:1552314395.traction: 53k ratings in CN (4.93) since Mar 2021; 1.1k US ratings; claims million-scale users; App Store Editor's Choice per description.
cn:1552314395.export_reason: Capture + resurfacing + AI insights are language-agnostic, the app has an EN UI and 1.1k US ratings; PKM/notes is crowded in the US (inference) and WeChat input is China-specific.
cn:1552314395.idea_seed: A thought diary where fleeting voice notes are auto-transcribed, a widget resurfaces one old entry each morning, and a weekly AI 'blind spot' reflection feeds identity and growth for US Gen Z women.
cn:1552314395.build_components: Quick capture (voice to text), tags/search, daily-review push/widget, LLM + embeddings for related notes and insights, sync, privacy controls.

cn:863837323.name_en: Migu Yuekan: Web Novels, Short Dramas & Audiobooks
cn:863837323.exclude_reason: Big-corporation media platform (Migu Digital Media, apparently the digital-media arm of a major telecom group - inference from the seller name) and pure entertainment content (web novels, short dramas); not a small developer, not self-improvement.
cn:863837323.what_it_is: Free web-novel, ad-free short-drama and audiobook streaming app.

kr:1549450444.what_it_is: Korean news-briefing app that makes news digestible with 1-minute summaries, an audio briefing, quizzes, explainers and an 'orange flame' habit streak (streak-like - inference).
kr:1549450444.sets_apart: Reframes news as a light daily habit for people with no time: 1-minute 'no time!' summaries, an audio briefing version, a quiz to review what you read, an opinion roundup on trending issues ('Pizza Station'), premium explainers on hard topics (economy, tech, humanities) and an 'orange flame' streak for the news habit.
kr:1549450444.lens_note: K2 relevant: bite-size summaries + quiz + explainers. K3 relevant: audio briefing for when there is no time to read. K1 loose: streak-based daily habit.
kr:1549450444.women_evidence: No gender cues in the description.
kr:1549450444.monetization: Free download; 'Premium Articles' indicate a paid tier (price not stated).
kr:1549450444.traction: 883 ratings in KR (4.11) since Jan 2022 (low app traction); 12 US ratings.
kr:1549450444.export_reason: The format (1-minute brief + audio + quiz + streak) is language-agnostic, but it is an editorial news product needing a content team and local context; the US news space is crowded and politically sensitive (inference).
kr:1549450444.idea_seed: A 'no time!' daily 1-minute brief with an audio version, a 3-question quiz and a streak, applied to a niche US Gen Z women care about (money, careers, wellness science) instead of general news.
kr:1549450444.build_components: Content pipeline (AI-assisted summaries + editorial review), TTS audio, quiz generator, streaks, push; editorial operations are the main cost.

kr:1518956326.name_en: My Routine: Routine, Habit & To-Do Planner (ADHD-friendly)
kr:1518956326.what_it_is: Emoji-based routine, to-do and schedule planner with widgets and watch support, a 'routine traffic light' and shared routine templates.
kr:1518956326.sets_apart: Records the day with cute emojis; 'rest' is a first-class entry beside 'done' so rest days are not failures; a routine traffic light and badges/stamps give feedback; users can borrow recommended routines from other 'routiners'; the title positions it as an ADHD-friendly daily planner.
kr:1518956326.lens_note: K1 core: routines, habits, diary and soft feedback with rest as a legitimate state.
kr:1518956326.women_evidence: Cute-emoji, pretty-record aesthetic, but no explicit female targeting.
kr:1518956326.monetization: Free download; paid tier not stated in the visible description (premium/subscription likely - inference).
kr:1518956326.traction: 25k ratings in KR (4.77) since Jul 2020; 3.3k US ratings; 18 store languages; updated Oct 2026.
kr:1518956326.export_reason: Emoji-first, content-free mechanic already localised to 18 languages with meaningful US adoption (3.3k ratings); no regulatory or content dependency.
kr:1518956326.idea_seed: An emoji-first routine planner for US Gen Z women where 'rest' counts as a check-in (no broken streaks), with a traffic-light day summary, routine templates from other users and ADHD-friendly daily planning.
kr:1518956326.build_components: Routine/to-do/schedule CRUD, emoji check-offs, stats ('traffic light'), badges/stamps, widgets and watch app, template library, reminders.

cn:1548407481.what_it_is: English vocabulary app for Chinese exam learners using forgetting-curve scheduling, with fully editable word banks, mnemonics and notes.
cn:1548407481.sets_apart: Everything about a word (definition, examples, mnemonics) is user-editable on top of official exam banks (CET-4/6, postgrad, study abroad), with a personalised memory curve; otherwise a standard SRS vocabulary drill.
cn:1548407481.lens_note: K2 relevant: user-built word banks + SRS review; no AI generation from user material.
cn:1548407481.monetization: Free download + VIP auto-renewing subscription (98 CNY/year with 3-day trial, per description).
cn:1548407481.traction: 69k ratings in CN (4.75) since May 2021; 413 US ratings; updated Oct 2026.
cn:1548407481.export_reason: Content/exam-bound (CET and postgrad exams for Chinese speakers); SRS with custom decks is a commodity (inference).
cn:1548407481.idea_seed: Lesson to borrow: let users edit every field and mnemonic on a card while the algorithm adapts, folded into an AI deck builder where the AI proposes and the user edits.
cn:1548407481.build_components: SRS scheduler, custom decks/notes, drill modes, dictionary lookup, subscription.

cn:1622788281.name_en: Monster Fasting: Intermittent Fasting & Calorie Tracker
cn:1622788281.what_it_is: Chinese intermittent-fasting app with fasting plans (7-day, popular, single-day), recipes, calorie lookup, weight log, workouts and AI photo calorie recognition.
cn:1622788281.sets_apart: Tiered fasting plans bundled with AI-generated recipes and photo calorie recognition; otherwise a standard fasting tracker with weight-loss copy ('lighter and prettier').
cn:1622788281.lens_note: K1 loose: routine/timer habit, but weight-loss centred rather than gentle self-improvement.
cn:1622788281.women_evidence: Weak: weight-loss and 'prettier' copy; no explicit female targeting.
cn:1622788281.monetization: Free download; paid plans/recipes not stated in the visible text (subscription likely - inference).
cn:1622788281.traction: 20k ratings in CN (4.59) since May 2022; not in US store.
cn:1622788281.export_reason: Fasting timers are language-agnostic, but weight-loss/fasting positioning for young women carries body-image, disordered-eating, store-policy and reputational risk; the mechanic itself is generic.
cn:1622788281.idea_seed: Do not copy the fasting angle; reuse only the 'timed window ring + plan tiers' for neutral rituals such as a phone-free evening window or a sleep window.
cn:1622788281.build_components: Window timer with ring UI, plan tiers, reminders, simple stats (AI food recognition is out of scope for the transferable slice).

jp:1060016132.name_en: abceed: TOEIC & English Learning with AI
jp:1060016132.what_it_is: Japanese English-learning platform combining 1,000+ popular exam textbooks (TOEIC/Eiken; publisher licensing inferred) with AI conversation practice, pronunciation scoring and weakness-based question recommendations.
jp:1060016132.sets_apart: Publisher textbook library digitised inside the app plus AI conversation/pronunciation feedback and an AI recommender that picks the next questions from 20,000+ by level and weakness; also movie-scene and news-clip learning.
jp:1060016132.lens_note: K2 loose: exam-prep drills and AI question picking, not user-supplied material. K3 loose: listening/dictation and spoken AI practice.
jp:1060016132.monetization: Free download; premium plan implied by 'unlimited AI conversation' (price not in the visible text).
jp:1060016132.traction: 57k ratings in JP (4.75) since Dec 2015; 315 US ratings; 6M users claimed.
jp:1060016132.export_reason: Core value is publisher-supplied Japanese exam content (TOEIC/Eiken; licensing inferred); the AI speaking practice and weakness recommender are portable but face crowded US language-learning competition (inference).
jp:1060016132.idea_seed: Borrow the recommender, not the library: an AI that picks 'your next 5 minutes' of practice from your weakest areas.
jp:1060016132.build_components: Recommendation engine over tagged items, speech recognition/pronunciation scoring, practice session UI; content licensing is out of scope.

kr:1490969385.name_en: MOCA: My Own AI Vocabulary Book
kr:1490969385.what_it_is: Solo-built personal flashcard app where you add your own words or patterns (any language or subject) and level up through word games.
kr:1490969385.sets_apart: Capacity is the currency: free card slots are earned by levelling up through word games (with rewarded ads) instead of a paywall (about 1,000 slots by level 40); subject-agnostic (languages, medicine, history, exams), iCloud sync and CSV import. The title says 'AI' but the visible description does not describe an AI feature.
kr:1490969385.lens_note: K2 relevant: user-supplied material drilled through gamified recall; manual entry/CSV, no auto-generation visible.
kr:1490969385.monetization: Free with rewarded ads; paid slot expansion implied (per description).
kr:1490969385.traction: 5.6k ratings in KR (4.79) since Jan 2020; 41 US ratings; 8 store languages.
kr:1490969385.export_reason: Subject- and language-agnostic, with global user reviews quoted in the listing, but a commodity feature set with low US traction (41 ratings).
kr:1490969385.idea_seed: Tie the free tier to learning behaviour: 'earn the right to add more of your own material by actually reviewing it' instead of a hard paywall.
kr:1490969385.build_components: Flashcard CRUD, gamified quiz modes with XP/levels, slot-based limits, iCloud/CSV import, rewarded ads.

cn:1148465254.name_en: Missevan (Cat-Ear FM): Audio Dramas & Sleep Voices
cn:1148465254.what_it_is: Chinese audio-drama platform with sleep-aid voices and voice live-streaming, funded by monthly or quarterly membership.
cn:1148465254.sets_apart: Voice-first ACG community product: audio dramas of novels and manga, soothing voices and ambient sounds for falling asleep, live voice rooms with voice actors and comedians with viewer tipping, and 'use fragmented time' listening while commuting, queueing or doing chores.
cn:1148465254.lens_note: K3 relevant: audio for chores/commute/sleep, but entertainment rather than goal-driven. K1 loose: soothing 'sleep with you' voices.
cn:1148465254.women_evidence: Genre tags include 'shoujo' and soothing male/female voices, but no explicit female targeting.
cn:1148465254.monetization: Free + membership subscription (19 CNY/month, 53 CNY/quarter) + tipping of streamers (per description).
cn:1148465254.traction: 47k ratings in CN (4.63) since Sep 2016; 236 US ratings.
cn:1148465254.export_reason: Content- and culture-bound (Mandarin audio dramas, ACG voice-actor fandom); live streaming and tipping add moderation and regulatory overhead; the 'sleep with a gentle voice' idea itself travels.
cn:1148465254.idea_seed: Gentle 'wind-down with me' sessions: a soothing narrator reads a short story personalised to the user's day, for US Gen Z women who use audio to fall asleep.
cn:1148465254.build_components: Audio player, personalised story generation (LLM + TTS/voice), sleep timer and ambient mixer, subscription; live streaming and tipping are out of scope for the slice.

cn:1112797670.what_it_is: Chinese business-education platform with professor-led video courses and offline learning centres, aimed at executives and entrepreneurs.
cn:1112797670.sets_apart: Thinking-model curriculum plus 'deliberate practice', learning centres in 18 cities with monthly events (learning as a community), and video lessons with synced transcripts, speed control and audio-only mode.
cn:1112797670.lens_note: Loose on all lenses: executive course platform with personal-growth tracks; audio-only mode and transcripts are the only micro-learning-like bits.
cn:1112797670.women_evidence: Audience is described as executives, entrepreneurs and professionals.
cn:1112797670.monetization: Free download; paid courses/memberships implied (not explicit).
cn:1112797670.traction: 44k ratings in CN (4.91) since Jul 2016; 233 US ratings; 5M students claimed.
cn:1112797670.export_reason: Content-, professor-brand- and offline-community-bound, aimed at executives; only 'video with synced transcript and audio mode' is portable and it is a commodity feature.

cn:1112797670.build_components: Video/audio player with synced transcripts, background audio, offline downloads, progress tracking.

jp:1564405189.name_en: My Word Book: Simple Flashcard App
jp:1564405189.what_it_is: Minimal solo-developer flashcard app: create folders of your own words with tags, read-aloud and a self-test mode.
jp:1564405189.sets_apart: Nothing structurally distinctive: blank-slate (no preloaded content), folders/tags, TTS read-aloud and cosmetic personalisation (theme colour, app-icon swap).
jp:1564405189.lens_note: K2 relevant only in that users supply the material and self-test; no generation or scheduling visible.
jp:1564405189.monetization: Free; none stated in the (short) description.
jp:1564405189.traction: 4.3k ratings in JP (4.68) since May 2021; 14 US ratings.
jp:1564405189.export_reason: Language-agnostic and tiny, but a commodity feature set with negligible US traction (14 ratings).
jp:1564405189.idea_seed: Cheap personalisation as self-expression: theme colours and app-icon swaps make a study utility feel like 'mine' for US Gen Z women.
jp:1564405189.build_components: Flashcard folders/tags, TTS, quiz mode, theme and alternate-icon settings.

cn:1534693988.name_en: Desktop Sticky Notes: Widget To-Do & Check-in
cn:1534693988.what_it_is: Widget-first sticky-note app that puts to-do, text and 28-day check-in notes on the iOS home screen with decorative paper styles.
cn:1534693988.sets_apart: The home-screen widget is the product: three note types (to-do, text, 28-day check-in) with stationery-style paper, fonts and backgrounds, Apple Pencil handwriting/drawing, a page-turn effect and no ads.
cn:1534693988.lens_note: K1 relevant: aesthetic planning and a 28-day check-in cycle on the home screen.
cn:1534693988.women_evidence: Decorative paper styles, handwriting and home-screen aesthetics suggest a style-conscious skew; no explicit female targeting.
cn:1534693988.monetization: Free download, no ads (per description); extra styles/features via IAP likely (inference).
cn:1534693988.traction: 16k ratings in CN (4.63) since Oct 2020; 166 US ratings; 5 store languages.
cn:1534693988.export_reason: Language-agnostic and visual, but widget-based design is iOS-centric (Android widgets differ) and the category is crowded with low US pull (166 ratings) (inference).
cn:1534693988.idea_seed: An aesthetic-first home-screen widget pack for US Gen Z women: a 28-day check-in sticker sheet and handwritten-style to-do notes that match the wallpaper, so the widget itself is the habit app.
cn:1534693988.build_components: WidgetKit widgets (iOS), note CRUD, paper/theme packs, Pencil drawing; Android widgets are a separate effort.

cn:6720721188.what_it_is: AI calorie-tracking and weight-loss app that logs food from a photo, voice, barcode or parsed takeout order, with an 'AI health buddy' and automatic monthly reviews.
cn:6720721188.sets_apart: Removes logging friction with multimodal AI (photo recognition, AR portion measuring, barcode, takeout-order parsing, say-it-to-log), an AI 'buddy' for adherence and an auto-generated monthly review report; the title also advertises a calorie 'lock' on takeout (not explained in the visible text).
cn:6720721188.lens_note: K1 loose: AI companion for adherence and monthly review, but diet-centred.
cn:6720721188.women_evidence: Mixed audience (fitness fans, diabetics); includes postpartum, pregnancy-prep and breastfeeding segments but no explicit female positioning.
cn:6720721188.monetization: Free download; paid tier not stated in the visible text (subscription likely - inference).
cn:6720721188.traction: 40k ratings in CN (4.73) within two years of its Oct 2024 release; 189 US ratings; 7 store languages.
cn:6720721188.export_reason: Food recognition relies on a Chinese food database and takeout-platform parsing (content-bound); diet/weight-loss targeting Gen Z women carries body-image, App Store policy and regulatory risk, and calorie tracking is crowded in the US (inference).
cn:6720721188.idea_seed: Reuse the zero-friction capture pattern for non-diet logging: snap or say it and AI fills in the details, e.g. a voice check-in for mood, skin or sleep with a one-line AI recap.
cn:6720721188.build_components: Photo/voice capture with multimodal LLM, structured logging UI, monthly report generation, notifications; food database and AR measuring are out of scope for the transferable slice.

cn:496145505.exclude_reason: State-broadcaster platform (China Media Group sound platform with 1,200+ radio frequencies and CCTV content per description): institutional, not a small developer, and news/radio content rather than self-improvement.

cn:1438382848.exclude_reason: Children's content app: parent-child story audio (picture books, English enlightenment, Chinese classics, history for kids aged 0-6 and primary school).
cn:1438382848.what_it_is: Audio story channel for children and parents from a family storytelling brand.

br:1177343870.what_it_is: Brazilian book-summary app that distils each book into a roughly 12-minute read or listen, with audiobooks and a '12min English' track.
br:1177343870.sets_apart: A fixed time-box as the brand promise ('the essence of a book in 12 minutes') in both text and audio, built for commute, gym or bedtime, with an English-learning track using summarised English books; strong cross-border traction.
br:1177343870.lens_note: K3 core: audio summaries for the commute, gym or before sleep. K2 relevant: time-boxed 'learn in minutes' digests (curated, not user-supplied). K1 loose: self-help and routine improvement.

br:1177343870.export_reason: Proven cross-market (BR with a 6.1k-rating US presence, PT/ES/EN) and the time-boxed digest is language-agnostic; content depends on licensed or produced summaries, and the category is established in the US (inference).
br:1177343870.idea_seed: A fixed 'your 12 minutes' promise for US Gen Z women: one time-boxed audio/text lesson per day matched to the goal, with session length adapting to the commute or workout duration.
br:1177343870.build_components: Audio/text player with offline, content pipeline (AI-generated or licensed summaries), recommendation by goal, subscription; content rights are the bottleneck.

jp:695090127.what_it_is: Photo/voice/video diary app built on the 10-year-diary format: one page per calendar date showing what you wrote on that date in each earlier year.
jp:695090127.sets_apart: 'Same date across years' layout makes every entry an automatic memory: from year two you see what you did a year ago on the same day; low-friction one-line entries aimed at people who quit diaries after three days; media attachments and device-change transfer.
jp:695090127.lens_note: K1 core: journaling and reflection with a long-term identity-over-time hook.
jp:695090127.women_evidence: Store copy uses 'cute' (kawaii) positioning and tags such as 'women' and 'love diary', but these look like SEO keyword stuffing, not an explicit audience statement.
jp:695090127.monetization: Free with ads; VIP membership removes ads (per description).
jp:695090127.traction: 30k ratings in JP (4.41) since Sep 2013; 152 US ratings.
jp:695090127.export_reason: Content-free, language-agnostic retention loop (same-date resurfacing); the diary category is crowded in the US and entries are sensitive (privacy) (inference).
jp:695090127.idea_seed: A one-page-per-date, many-years journal for US Gen Z women: a one-line daily entry, and any day shows what you wrote on that date in past years, with a shareable year-over-year-me recap.
jp:695090127.build_components: Diary CRUD with media attachments, same-date multi-year view, on-this-day notifications, backup/sync, ad/VIP gating.

vn:1447395824.lens_note: K3 core: audio library positioned for driving/jogging/cooking; no personalisation. K1/K2 loose: meditation and sleep content, book summaries.

vn:1447395824.build_components: Audio player (background/offline), subscription paywall, content catalogue/CMS, voice tiering; content licensing is out of scope.

cn:1600837891.name_en: Cheese Words: Vocabulary with Hamster Pets
cn:1600837891.what_it_is: English vocabulary app for Chinese exam learners wrapped in a pet-collecting game: finished study sessions earn blind-box tickets that summon collectible hamsters, plus cheese to feed them and furniture to decorate their house.
cn:1600837891.sets_apart: Gacha/blind-box + pet-care + home-decoration economy layered on an SRS vocabulary app: study, check-ins and reviews all earn tickets, cheese and props, and special furniture unlocks via tasks or hidden easter eggs; ad-free and cute-focused.
cn:1600837891.lens_note: K1 core mechanic: cute pet companions + soft discipline + decoration as reward (content is exam vocabulary). K2 relevant: SRS vocabulary drill on the Ebbinghaus curve.
cn:1600837891.women_evidence: Cute pets, house decoration and blind-box collecting suggest an aesthetic/youth skew; no explicit female targeting.
cn:1600837891.monetization: Free and ad-free (per description) with an auto-renewing membership; in-app currency (cheese) and blind-box tickets.
cn:1600837891.traction: 87k ratings in CN (4.75) since Dec 2021; not in US store.
cn:1600837891.export_reason: Pet-collection + decoration economy is language-agnostic and can sit on top of any learning or habit action; vocabulary content is exam-bound, and blind-box/lottery mechanics invite regulatory and App Store scrutiny (inference).
cn:1600837891.idea_seed: A study/habit companion economy for US Gen Z women: each completed review or habit earns currency to feed and decorate a collectible pet's cosy room, with surprise drops tied to effort rather than money.
cn:1600837891.build_components: SRS or habit engine, pet/inventory/economy system, 2D room decorator with animations, drop logic, store; art asset pipeline for pets and furniture.
